description: Check a credit card surcharge before you charge it. Send the surcharge percent, the cap that applies to you (from your card network's rules, your acquirer or state law; send 0 where surcharges are banned) and your cost of acceptance in percent (your effective card fee rate for that card brand). Optionally the card kind and a sale amount. Get back the highest surcharge allowed (the lower of the cap and the cost of acceptance; 0 on debit or prepaid cards under U.S. Visa and Mastercard rules), every breach by name, how far over, and in money for the sale amount: the surcharge, the most allowed and the excess. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/surcharge-cap-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

cap_percent.description: The cap that applies to you in percent (from your network rules, acquirer contract or state law; 0 where banned).

card_kind.description: Card kind: credit (default), debit or prepaid (U.S. Visa and Mastercard rules allow no surcharge on debit or prepaid).

cost_of_acceptance_percent.description: Your cost of accepting the card in percent of sales (your effective merchant discount rate for that brand).

label.description: Optional label (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

sale_amount.description: Optional sale amount before the surcharge, to show the surcharge in money.

surcharge_percent.description: The surcharge you charge or plan to charge, in percent of the sale (3 for 3%).

name: surcharge_cap_check
title: Card Surcharge Cap Check
